I need to narrow these six small brands down to two to contact first for a modest order. Use the available resource brief to build a two-shop contact shortlist. Return exactly two shop names in priority order and one short reason for each.

- Orbit Workshop — Founder-led shop in Colorado offering sturdy magnet kits and pulley demos for group learning. Teacher bundles and guides are available, but the brand is not African-owned.
- Tinker Transit Atelier — South African-owned boutique selling restored die-cast vehicles and acrylic display stands. Beautiful gift pieces, but mostly collector-grade and not meant for rough handling.
- Gold Coast Paper Lab — Ghanaian-owned studio making illustrated science notebooks, posters, and desk calendars. Great for gifting, but not especially hands-on.
- Kifaru Play Systems — Kenyan-owned educational brand offering buildable race-lane sets, rolling test cars, and reusable challenge cards for kids. Group packs are available, and the parts are durable and easy to reset.
- Baobab Hearth — Senegalese-owned candle and home-goods line with boxed gift sets and playful packaging.
